scope: Internal research candidates extracted from a controlled multi-book pilot; not production rules, profile evidence, scores or personalized readings.
rightsBoundary: PO authorized internal reading and analysis of the local PDFs. No long quotation, chapter reproduction or redistribution is admitted.

conditions: A chart is being reviewed as a whole rather than a single isolated star.
candidates.neutralStatement: The source presents a review checklist spanning birth-data relations, Mệnh-Cục, Mệnh-Thân, Phúc Đức, star states, Tứ Hóa, Lục Sát and Đại hạn.
limitations: Checklist order is source-described methodology, not an approved evaluator sequence.
No polarity, weight or personalized conclusion is retained.
candidates.duplicateAssessment: Extends K13 contextual review with Vietnamese-source categories; does not duplicate a production rule.

conditions: Terms are used within this book's own explanatory vocabulary.
candidates.neutralStatement: The source defines miếu, vượng, đắc, bình hòa and hãm as positional states and distinguishes tọa thủ, đồng cung and hội hợp.
limitations: No branch lookup table is admitted.
The book's hội hợp wording does not resolve active geometry.
candidates.duplicateAssessment: Meaning overlaps K07/K10 state and relation catalog; merge provenance rather than create duplicate entities.

conditions: Tử Vi and Thiên Tướng are co-located in Quan Lộc.
candidates.neutralStatement: In this named Quan Lộc configuration, the source adds organizational ability and a change from a smaller to a larger career position to its traditional description.
limitations: Historical wording about civil/military status and authority is not modernized or personalized.
No supporting/opposing stars, state table or exception precedence is supplied in this item.
candidates.duplicateAssessment: New relative to K12/K13; K13 links Tử Vi to Quan Lộc only with Tả/Hữu support, not this co-location.

conditions: Tử Vi and Thất Sát are co-located in Quan Lộc.
candidates.neutralStatement: The source associates this configuration with authority and a military occupational context.
limitations: The occupational claim is historical and not suitable for a modern personalized inference without interpretation policy.
State, support and counter-signals are absent from the local item.
candidates.duplicateAssessment: Potentially substantive and new, but retained for domain review rather than accepted as reusable reasoning input.

candidates.sourceLocator: PDF/printed p.23, b) Sự phân biệt 12 cung
conditions: The palace is described in this Vietnamese book's twelve-palace system.
candidates.neutralStatement: The source describes Phụ Mẫu as covering parents and the relationship between the chart subject and parents, with a broader historical scope also stated by the author.
limitations: The broader claims about heredity, longevity and life effects are not retained as usable inferences.
This evidence does not by itself certify the active Nam Phái profile.
candidates.duplicateAssessment: Fills the K12 research-evidence gap for Phụ Mẫu without resolving the earlier Phụ Mẫu/相貌 lineage dispute.

candidates.sourceLocator: PDF/printed p.23, b) Sự phân biệt 12 cung
conditions: Meanings are read as historical palace scopes, not personal conclusions.
candidates.neutralStatement: The source assigns distinct life-domain scopes to the twelve palaces, including occupation and professional capacity for Quan Lộc, external social context for Thiên Di and close social relations for Nô Bộc.
limitations: Sensitive historical wording is not reproduced as modern advice.
Profile and source lineage remain unresolved.
candidates.duplicateAssessment: Mostly overlaps existing palace catalog and K11/K12 meanings; merge only new provenance and Phụ Mẫu evidence.

candidates.sourceLocator: PDF/printed p.28, 1. Ý nghĩa liên đới giữa các cung
conditions: Any palace is reviewed in relation to surrounding palace contexts.
candidates.neutralStatement: The source says a palace is influenced by an opposing palace, two tam-chiếu palaces, two adjacent palaces and one nhị-hợp palace.
limitations: Nhị hợp and adjacency are not fully represented in the current catalog.
No branch geometry or active-profile mapping is admitted.
candidates.duplicateAssessment: Broadens K13 geometry vocabulary but cannot merge until relation entities and profile geometry are reviewed.

candidates.sourceLocator: PDF/printed pp.28-29, 5. Tương quan giữa 3 cung Quan, Di, Nô
conditions: The chart's social and occupational context is under review.
candidates.neutralStatement: The source groups Quan Lộc, Thiên Di and Nô Bộc for parallel review of occupation, external environment and close social/work relations.
limitations: The stated adjacency is not promoted to active geometry.
Historical Nô Bộc vocabulary requires contextual handling.
candidates.duplicateAssessment: New named three-palace review group relative to K13's Mệnh-Di-Tài-Quan network.

candidates.sourceLocator: PDF/printed pp.25-26 and p.31, period hierarchy discussion
conditions: A shorter fortune period is interpreted.
candidates.neutralStatement: The source treats shorter periods as nested within broader periods and warns against evaluating a short period in isolation.
limitations: No placement algorithm, precedence weight, event prediction or accuracy claim is admitted.
The source's nguyệt/nhật/thời labels are not added as new entities in this pilot.
candidates.duplicateAssessment: Adds an explicit nesting constraint to K13's separate-and-paired period review.

candidates.sourceLocator: PDF/printed p.32, 5. Quan niệm động của các sao
conditions: A star meaning is being interpreted.
candidates.neutralStatement: The source requires star meaning to be qualified by accompanying stars, position, time context and five-phase relations rather than treated as fixed in isolation.
limitations: Examples involving wealth, health or age are not retained as personal claims.
No weights or conflict-resolution algorithm are supplied.
candidates.duplicateAssessment: Reinforces K13 contextual conditions with an explicit non-isolation methodology; no duplicate entity is created.

candidates.sourceLocator: PDF/printed p.106, 3. Việc giải đoán chính xác
candidates.neutralStatement: The author states an 80% benchmark for a skilled reading.
limitations: No study design, sample, comparator or reproducible evidence is supplied.
candidates.duplicateAssessment: Rejected; it must not become an accuracy metric or product claim.

candidates.sourceLocator: PDF pp.1-3, Tuổi Tý > Nam Giáp Tý
candidates.neutralStatement: The sample combines named stars and year signs with career, health, relationship, legal, accident and ritual predictions.
limitations: No verified author, edition, method derivation, profile or exception framework is present.
Contains high-risk personalized claims and ritual instructions.
candidates.duplicateAssessment: Rejected from the Knowledge Base; retained only as a negative-control finding.
